description: 30 short, context-led levels; project-authored examples plus attributed user-supplied questions.

levels.title: A wider world
levels.definition: uninterested in ideas outside your own group

examples.en: His insular outlook left little room for unfamiliar ideas.
examples.zh: 他的观念狭隘保守，几乎容不下陌生的想法。

examples.en: The club became less insular when it welcomed students from abroad.
examples.zh: 接纳海外学生后，俱乐部不再那么封闭。

questions.prompt: Our club only listens to people who grew up here.

It seems eager to explore other cultures.

questions.prompt: The club became less _____ when it welcomed students from abroad.

questions.translation: 接纳海外学生后，俱乐部不再那么封闭。

levels.title: After a setback

levels.title: Before it happened
levels.definition: correctly suggesting what will happen in the future

examples.zh: 多年后，她当初带有预见性的警告被证明是准确的。

questions.prompt: Her warning about the old bridge turned out to be _____.

levels.title: At the negotiating table

examples.zh: 双方都不肯让步，谈判因此无果而终。

questions.prompt: Both sides remained _____, so the talks ended without a deal.

questions.explanation: We tested the idea with fifty users to collect empirical evidence.
questions.translation: 我们让五十位用户测试了这个想法，以收集实证证据。
